pages.text: The Source Linker is an item that can be used to link Block Instruments, Receivers, and Relays to a Transmitter.$(br2)To use a Source Linker, craft one and then shift + right-click on a Transmitter source (Player, Server Transmitter, or Relay) to link to that Transmitter. Then, right-click on any blocks you want to link to the Transmitter.
